Our Projects

Our projects — our pride!
Thanks to accumulated experience and established business relationships, our projects are implemented on time and within budget, ensuring reliable results and compliance with all legal requirements for our clients.

Pipeline installation for food and chemical industry companies

  • Installation of advanced systems for transporting liquids, gases, and bulk materials

  • Compliance with strict safety requirements and hygiene standards

  • Welding of pipes from stainless and highly alloyed steel, titanium, aluminum, and other materials, taking into account chemical and thermal environment properties

Manufacturing and commissioning of conveyor systems and rollers

  • Design and manufacturing of conveyors for continuous material transport in food, chemical, and other industries

  • On-site equipment installation and commissioning, customer personnel training

  • Integration with existing production lines, taking into account limited space and production process specifications

Manufacturing of tanks for dairy products, beverages, and aggressive environments

  • Manufacturing of tanks of various volumes and configurations — from standard to fully customized solutions

  • Use of high-quality alloys ensuring corrosion resistance, thermal insulation, and hermeticity

  • Possibility of installing heating/cooling systems, mixers, and control sensors (temperature, level, pressure, etc.)

Installation of additional and maintenance platforms in the pharmaceutical sector

  • Manufacturing and installation of metal structures meeting sterility requirements and GMP standards

  • Design of platforms for safe maintenance of technology lines and equipment, including multi-story spaces

  • Smart solutions optimizing work processes, increasing personnel safety and comfort

Each of our projects — that's precision, reliability, and attention to detail.
Get acquainted with our completed works in the gallery!

Project Gallery

Project Work Stages

Consultation

At the first consultation, we clarify the main requirements and specifics of the project, answer the client's questions, and discuss the further work plan.

1

Analysis and Planning

We determine technical parameters, deadlines, and budget, taking into account industry nuances and local regulations.

2

Design

We create detailed drawings and 3D models, coordinate specifications, and material delivery schedules.

3

Production and Welding Works

We use modern technologies (WIG–TIG, MIG–MAG, orbital welding, and others) and certified materials.

4

Installation and Verification

Experienced teams go to the site, perform installation and commissioning. We conduct tests for tightness, strength, and compliance with technical requirements.

5

Handover and Service

We prepare necessary documentation (certificates, acceptance reports), provide warranties, and if needed, ensure service maintenance.

6

We use only high-quality materials and equipment

We use only verified metallurgy and work only with reliable suppliers whose materials meet international quality and safety standards. In the selection process, we consider parameters such as chemical composition, mechanical properties, corrosion resistance, and metal product certification.

Thanks to strict controls at all stages — from procurement to preliminary control in production — we can guarantee the stability of metal and alloy properties, which directly affects the longevity and reliability of finished structures.

To ensure high quality and reliability in welding and installation work, our company uses a modern complex of equipment and technologies. We continuously modernize our machine and welding equipment fleet, improving production processes and ensuring stable results even when implementing highly complex projects.
